issue_request: FHIR-14150 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It requested adding Reference(Media) to ClinicalImpression.investigation.item and ClinicalImpression.finding.itemReference, and replacing finding.item[x] with itemCodeableConcept plus itemReference so both a codeable concept and a reference could be conveyed.
initial_application: Commit 1051f7d9e92921d517519953657b5f739b0ed15a applied the request by adding Media to ClinicalImpression.investigation.item, splitting finding.item[x] into itemCodeableConcept and itemReference, adding Reference(Media) to itemReference, and marking the affected rows GF#14150.
additional_context: FHIR-18860 later removed ClinicalImpression.investigation and clarified that supportingInfo contains investigation results. FHIR-19250 later merged Media into DocumentReference and changed the ClinicalImpression Media references to DocumentReference. FHIR-46596 renamed ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment, and the 2025 fhir.ini cleanup removed ClinicalAssessment from the active [resources] list. Current checked-in ClinicalImpression and ClinicalAssessment files are therefore out of current-build scope; the inactive ClinicalAssessment definition retains the GF#14150 note, targets DocumentReference on finding.item, and uses supportingInfo Reference(Resource) for investigation results.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Reintroducing Media into inactive ClinicalImpression or ClinicalAssessment source would conflict with the later Media-to-DocumentReference decision and would not affect the current build because neither ClinicalImpression nor ClinicalAssessment has an active source/fhir.ini [resources] entry.
